subject.title: feat(gateway): add configurable Control UI title

question: Should OpenClaw accept a static `gateway.controlUi.title` operator config key, and should that configured title override dynamic session- or agent-derived browser titles?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but accepting a new strict config key and a permanent title precedence policy is a product/config-surface decision that automation should not infer from an external PR alone.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this external PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if static instance-wide titles become accepted product direction.

options.title: Sponsor Static Title Config
options.body: A maintainer can request a refreshed PR that keeps this implementation shape and documents configured-title precedence over dynamic titles.

options.title: Prefer Dynamic Titles
options.body: Keep browser-title work on the dynamic session/agent-title path and avoid adding a new operator config key for static titles.

recommendation.body: Close this external PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if static instance-wide titles become accepted product direction.
